information: A confirmation email will be sent to all competitors who have completed the registration form here. You need complete the instructions in that email in order to get your registration approved. No walk-in registration is allowed for this competition. Registration fees are S$10 for the first event and S$2 each for additional events, till a maximum of S$30. The deadline for online registration is 13 February 2016.
